def factor_ewm_log_volume_weighted_return_spread(df):
    """Decay-weighted volume-coherence spread: ewm volume-weighted return minus ewm equally weighted return."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    log_vol = np.log1p(df_copy["volume"])
    vw_num = (ret * log_vol).ewm(span=20, adjust=False, min_periods=5).mean()
    vw_den = log_vol.ewm(span=20, adjust=False, min_periods=5).mean()
    vw_ret = vw_num / vw_den.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    simple_ret = ret.ewm(span=20, adjust=False, min_periods=5).mean()
    df_copy["factor_ewm_log_volume_weighted_return_spread"] = vw_ret - simple_ret
    return df_copy["factor_ewm_log_volume_weighted_return_spread"]
